headline: Rovinari: Employees of a CEO's service provider without wages for 5 months!
summary: Employees of a firm providing services to the Oltenia Energy Complex have not received wages for five months. They stopped work in Rovinari on Monday.
why: Oltenia Energy Complex is a major Romanian coal-based power producer, and labour disruption at its contractors can affect local generation operations.
